subject: English Language
question:
According to the passage, which among the following statements is 
true?
q:
According to the passage, which among the following statements is 
true?

options.text:
Sleep allows us to enhance our ability of acquiring knowledge 
and process emotional experiences.

An adult can function properly only with a quality sleep of 5-6 
hours a day.

Sleep deprivation can be cured only with a help of a medical 
professional.

explanation:
Only statement (a) is accurate: “Sleep 
helps consolidate and store memories, 
process emotional experiences, replenish 
glucose (the brain’s energy source), and 
clear beta-amyloid (a waste product that 
accumulates in Alzheimer’s patients and 
interferes with cognitive function).”
For statement (b), refer to the first paragraph: 
“An adult needs 7 to 8 hours of good-quality, 
uninterrupted sleep each day.”
For statement (c), refer to the last paragraph: 
“The easiest way to address sleep deprivation 
is to get more sleep.”
direction:
Read the following passage and answer the following 
questions based on the given passage. Some of the words are highlighted 
which would help you to answer some of the questions given.
A good night’s sleep is crucial for maintaining overall health and well-
being. It allows the body to rest, recharge, and repair itself. For adults, 
getting 7 to 8 hours of uninterrupted, quality sleep each night is essential 
to support physical and mental health. Sleep deprivation can be defined 
as inability to complete the sufficient sleep-time required by the person.

subject: English Language
question:
What is/are the cause(s) of incompetency in a sleep deprived 
individual’s brain?
	
(i) Clearing out of beta-amyloid that disrupts cognitive activity.
	
(ii) Sleep deprivation leads to drowsiness, tiredness and reduced 
alertness.
	
(iii) Reduction in the regrowth or repair of nervous tissues, cells or 
cell products in the cerebral cortex.
q:
What is/are the cause(s) of incompetency in a sleep deprived 
individual’s brain?
	
(i) Clearing out of beta-amyloid that disrupts cognitive activity.
	
(ii) Sleep deprivation leads to drowsiness, tiredness and reduced 
alertness.
	
(iii) Reduction in the regrowth or repair of nervous tissues, cells or 
cell products in the cerebral cortex.
explanation:
Refer to the final sentence of the 
third paragraph: “During sleep, neuron 
regeneration occurs in the cerebral cortex. 
Thus, a sleep-deprived person’s brain cannot 
function at its best.” Therefore, option (b) 
is correct.
